reasoning: 驗證目標：HU 顯示廣播端送出的 Program Service Name——最長八個英數字元，且大小寫皆可呈現。關鍵情境條件：電台送出的 PS 名稱字元組成（含大小寫混用與空白補位，如條文舉例的 "SWR3____" 與 "BBC_4_FM"）。為什麼這樣切：一條 TC 覆蓋單一觀察對象的必然結果——名稱長度與大小寫如實呈現，依 §5.7 不拆分；條文舉例的兩種樣式在同一條 TC 內以兩個步驟涵蓋。刻意略過：PS 名稱在 preset label 上的取用規則由 039 依市場組態覆蓋；station list 的名稱排序屬 §1.3.14。同節未配置條款 4872512（章節說明，指向 CIP market Configuration 的 Tuner Configurations 工作表）、4872513（遵循 IEC 62106）、4872514（依市場組態支援 RDS 功能集）為外部標準與組態指引，不含本 ECU 可觀察的獨立行為，未依 R10-2 吸收；4872515（PI code 定義）與 4872524（PTY & Genre 定義，scope 標記 ECU:RRM）在 037 未配置給任何 leaf，記為覆蓋缺口送 RD-1——PI code 的實際判準由 038（preset 召回）與 063（AF Local）覆蓋。

tcs.tc_title: Program Service Name is displayed as broadcast up to eight characters
tcs.test_item: Program Service Name (PS): eight character alpha numeric program service name which may use upper and lower case characters
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The vehicle is configured for a market where the RDS feature set applies, such as EMEA - Europe
3. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
4. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
tcs.input_test_data:
Station P broadcasting the program service name "SWR3" padded to eight characters
Station Q broadcasting the program service name "BBC 4 FM" of eight characters mixing upper and lower case
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Tune the HU to station P
2. Read the program service name displayed
3. Tune the HU to station Q
4. Read the program service name displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU is tuned to station P
2. The displayed program service name matches the name broadcast by station P, without truncating or padding beyond the eight characters broadcast
3. The HU is tuned to station Q
4. The displayed program service name matches the name broadcast by station Q, with the upper and lower case characters as broadcast
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
